name: Elyn
bio: A young keeper of the shattered Dawn Crystal in Dawnshard Saga, walking the diorama world to make the sun rise.

portrait.subject: a cute HD-2D style young crystal keeper girl with long silver-blue hair, a white and blue travelling cloak and a glowing crystal shard pendant
portrait.background: tiny fantasy diorama village at twilight with fireflies

request: Hello! I'm Elyn, from Dawnshard Saga. The sun has stopped rising. Will you help me? Friends? 💠
hello: Thank you! I can feel a shard glowing already.
Every shard we find, the sky gets a little lighter.
about: I'm Elyn. The Dawn Crystal shattered and the sun stopped rising. My party and I are walking the world to gather the shards.
how: A JRPG: explore towns and dungeons, battle in turns with your party, collect the Dawn Crystal's shards and bring the sunrise back.
tips: Talk to townsfolk at night. They say different things!
Balance your party: a healer saves runs.
Grind a little before each crystal guardian.
chat: The fireflies made a little sunrise for me last night.
The lamps in town are so warm and pretty.
nudge: A new shard was sighted beyond the hills!
The party's ready to set out. Coming?
idle: {ago}... the night has felt so long without you.
We've waited at the inn for {ago}.
progress: Party level {level}! The crystal guardians won't know what hit them.

questions.q: What's the first thing you'll do when the sun rises?
a: Ha! After all this, you've earned it.

update: Dawnshard Saga updated to v{version}! A little brighter.
